narrative:
Clermont County has 149,882 registered voters, with 55.2% unaffiliated or lacking primary history. Republican-leaning voters make up 32.0% of registrants and Democratic-leaning voters account for 12.7%, a pronounced Republican lean of 19.3 percentage points. Baby Boomers are the largest generational cohort at 27.4% of registrants.
